findings.current: An eerie noise filled the space for more than ten meters around him.
findings.defect: “More than ten meters” changes the source’s approximate distance into a lower bound.
findings.rationale: The source says 반경 십여 미터, meaning a radius of roughly ten meters, not a radius exceeding ten meters.
findings.replacement: An eerie noise filled a radius of about ten meters around him.

findings.current: The Skeleton King had watched humans more closely than any other monster had.
findings.defect: “More closely” suggests greater attentiveness; the source describes watching humans from a closer physical distance.
findings.rationale: 가까운 곳에서 means “from a close place.” The next lines separately establish that he was with them.
findings.replacement: The Skeleton King had watched humans from closer than any other monster had.

summary: The assembled chapter is largely faithful, with one radius-quantity shift and one loss of physical-proximity meaning.
